audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text credited Kled's Bear Trap with percent-max-HP damage and Sejuani's W with percent-HP damage.
audit.why: Neither ability carries a percentHealth flag and neither Riot description mentions percent health. Kled Q is flat physical plus a yank; Winter's Wrath is damage, slow and Frost stacks.
audit.corrected: Percent-HP claims removed from spikes[1], whys[2], whys[3], whys[5], mid and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: Text repeatedly claimed Sejuani 'has no dash', is an 'immobile tank with no dash' and 'can't disengage'. It also called Permafrost her chip damage and called Glacial Prison an 'AOE permafrost stun'.
audit.why: Arctic Assault is a 650-range charge that knocks up and stops on the first champion hit — 18s at rank 1. It is both her gap-closer and her disengage, and its knockup interrupts Kled's E dash and R charge. Permafrost is a 1.5s single-target stun that only fires on a MAX-Frost target, and the Frost comes from Winter's Wrath; her passive then shatters a stunned enemy for heavy magic damage. Glacial Prison is the bola.
audit.corrected: All 'no dash' lines replaced with the 18s Arctic Assault window; Frost-then-Permafrost order stated; names separated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kled's slow was treated as a lock.
audit.why: Frost Armor grants immunity to slows while it is up, so Bear Trap's slow does nothing to a Sejuani who has been out of combat — only the yank matters. The mirror states the same fact from her side.
audit.corrected: wants.you[0] now says the pull, not the slow, is the lock.

edits.before: Sejuani has no burst and no escape, so once your W shotgun shots are online at 2 you out-trade her every time — bait her permafrost chip, then E in, Q the Bear Trap and yank, W the on-hit shots. Your only real respect is her E stun: if she lands the frost stack and stuns you mid-dash you lose the trade tempo, so don't E straight through her when her passive is primed. At level 1 just last-hit and keep Skaarl's mount health full; her percent-HP W nibbles but can't out-damage your remount sustain.
edits.after: Sejuani has no burst, so once Violent Tendencies is online at 2 you out-trade her — bait Arctic Assault, 18s at rank 1 and her only gap-closer, then E in, Q the Bear Trap and yank, W the four attacks. Respect the order behind her stun: Winter's Wrath applies Frost, and only at max stacks does Permafrost fire, after which her passive shatters a stunned target for heavy magic damage. At level 1 last-hit and keep Skaarl full; her mace chip can't out-damage your remount sustain.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are yours — you stack W procs and your percent-max-HP Q chunks her stacked-resist health bar faster than she can heal or chip you back, and the remount keeps your effective health topped between trades. At 6 your R is the better solo tool: knock her into your tower or extend a gank, while her R alone never kills you 1v1. Keep forcing all-ins on her E cooldown; an immobile tank with no dash can't disengage your re-E once you commit.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are yours — Violent Tendencies plus the Bear Trap yank chunks her faster than Winter's Wrath chips back, and the remount keeps your effective health topped between trades. At 6 your R is the better solo tool: ram her into your tower or extend a gank, while Glacial Prison alone never kills you 1v1. Force all-ins right after Arctic Assault: it is her gap-closer and her disengage in one button, and it is down 18s at rank 1.

edits.before: This is where she flips it — Sejuani is built for the 5v5, and a single R Glacial Prison into your carries wins fights your lane lead can't undo. Your frontloaded burst flattens against her stacked resists once she's tanky, and you can't solo-delete her anymore. Close the game on your item-spike timing and use R roams to snowball other lanes early, because if it goes long her AOE permafrost stun out-values your single-target bully kit.
